item.title: A new media ecosystem is emerging on the left, reshaping Democratic politics
item.description: More progressive Americans are turning away from traditional media

item.title: One fatality reported after small plane crash near Chandler Airport in Arizona
item.description: A small aircraft crash near Chandler Airport in Arizona resulted in one death, fire officials confirmed.

item.title: Japan earthquake death toll rises; missing persons in mall and factory
item.description: At least 18 people died in the powerful earthquake in southern Japan, with more missing in a shopping mall and a paper factory.

item.title: Fauci testifies before Senate panel after Rand Paul releases diary entries
item.description: Dr. Anthony Fauci is testifying before the Senate about the origins of COVID-19, facing a confrontation with Senator Rand Paul.
